title: Tunnel Malposition
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Say that the plan depends on whether the existing tunnel can be avoided, reused, or must be grafted, and that only a quantified assessment answers that.
State the three routes: a new independent tunnel where the old position allows it, reuse where the position is acceptable, and staged bone grafting where it is neither.
State that hardware removal may be required and may itself dictate staging.
State that an unaddressed secondary restraint or malalignment is corrected in the same plan, because a correctly placed graft in a varus or rotationally deficient knee fails again.
State position, width and available bone before stating the number of stages.
Take all five explicitly rather than by impression, and separate the measurement from the attribution when you say it out loud.
